silhouette.reason: A flat slab with low block heaps, ring footings with a stepped crown and the askew survey banner as the only vertical; from FRONT and SIDE it is a thin strip with a pole. It reads as "something destroyed" rather than "the barracks site".
fixes: a leaning charred timber frame or a standing footing pier ~1.5 m on one corner so the strip outline breaks

proportions.reason: 15.5 x 18.0 x 3.5 m; rubble blocks now vary in size, the banner pole stands askew at a believable height.
fixes: lower the banner tilt so it reads deliberate (10-15 deg) rather than about to fall out of the box

materials.reason: Fallen team slates are broken into pieces now, footing tops are stepped blocks; but the slab is the blotchy camouflage pattern and the slates are clean saturated red, so the ruin reads painted rather than burnt.
fixes: char/dust on the fallen slates (value down, roughness up)
slab on a flagstone/rammed-earth strip with burnt patches

detail.reason: Broken slates, charred beams with a few small shards, stepped footing crowns, block heaps; the heaps are sparse and the floor between is bare.
fixes: gravel and small shards round each heap (lots of 5-10 cm pieces)

wear.reason: Raking.png and hero.png show crisp bevelled cube blocks, a little damp at the drum foot and no scorch, soot or ash anywhere; the fallen team slates are still bright saturated red, not dusty or charred. The collapse is told by arrangement only, not by surface.
fixes: scorch and soot on the broken wall tops and on the floor round the heap (rubble() in site.ts): dark, low-roughness patches that read at hero distance
dust/char coat on the fallen team slates (fallenSlabs) so the red reads buried, value down ~40%
chip one or two arrises per rubble block instead of whole clean cubes

lod.reason: lods.png: LOD2 (362 tris) keeps footings, banner, heap blocks and a few tilted slates; the red slab pattern holds. Footings become octagons and the floor pattern flattens to grey.
fixes: 10-12 sides on the footing rings at LOD2

technical.reason: QA PASS, tris 14.4k / 2.6k / 362, draws 2/2/2; one trim material + team slot, LOD2 well under 1k. Triangles mostly sit in the running-bond blocks and slates, where they show.
